title: Meta says it will allow its AI glasses users to opt out of having their "visual data" used to train its AI or shown to third-party contractors outside the US (Karissa Bell/Engadget)
summary: Karissa Bell / Engadget: Meta says it will allow its AI glasses users to opt out of having their “visual data” used to train its AI or shown to third-party contractors outside the US — Somewhere, a contractor just breathed a sigh of relief. — Meta is making another concession to privacy critics …
